name: waveform
title: Waveform
description: A canvas of bars packed edge to edge (or spaced with gap) whose lengths trace a moving wave, horizontal or vertical. Built-in sine, interference, ripple, packet, terrain, spectrum, voice, heartbeat and breathe patterns, a custom wave(x, t) function, or a controlled value. Bottom, top or mirrored center anchors; sunset, aurora, ocean, ember, candy and neon palettes or custom colors, with tip, span or level gradients and tip or edge fades; a hover bump.
